name: cryptosweep
description: Post-quantum cryptography scanner: inventory cryptography, flag quantum-vulnerable primitives, and compute harvest-now-decrypt-later (Mosca-clock) risk.
author: maximilliangrand

tools.name: scan
tools.description: Scan a target (hostname/URL, public GitHub owner/repo, or a directory under the configured root) for quantum-vulnerable cryptography; returns the inventory, the harvest-now-decrypt-later (Mosca-clock) risk assessment and what the scan covered.

tools.name: data_classes
tools.description: List the confidentiality data classes and their secrecy horizons available for the risk model.
